description: This file defines the interface and factory for the Control component within the Rialto client namespace. It includes class declarations for ControlFactory and Control, which manage control clients and interact with the IClientController. The file sets up the structure for creating and managing control objects and their clients in the Rialto media client.

classes.name: ControlFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Control instances, implementing the IControlFactory interface.

classes.name: Control
classes.description: Implements the IControl interface, manages control clients, and interacts with the IClientController.

methods.name: createControl
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControl instance.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a ControlFactory instance.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a control client with the Control instance, associating it with the application state.
